audit_reference.review_status: provisional single AI visual review of private frame sequences; no independent human adjudication
audit_reference.support: Stage 4.1 raw class support, 1 uncertain excluded from precision/recall

method.scene_cuts: Stored Stage 4.2 production threshold-27 outputs reproduced against pilot baseline; never repaired truth
method.cut_rule: previous_sample_timestamp < cut_timestamp <= current_sample_timestamp; mask the crossing cell
method.simplification: After A-B-A suppression, keep originally null flow cells as gaps; map existing local_motion with coverage <=0.4 to local_motion, every other non-null class (including unknown) to motion_present
method.descriptor_basis: All-pixel mean magnitude; active-pixel coverage; active median vector magnitude, coherence and radial alignment exactly as classifier computes. Null descriptors where no active pixels.
method.event_descriptors: Arithmetic mean of contributing sample measurements; sample_count counts non-null raw flow cells. Cut-crossing cells excluded. Baseline uses matching original-class cells. Legacy semantic confidence is kept on raw samples and semantic comparators only.
method.rounding: Event times follow existing Stage 4 builders at millisecond precision; descriptors use full-precision replay.

variant_definitions.existing_semantic_output: Exact reconstructed production semantic events, including overlap
variant_definitions.nonoverlap_plus_singleton: Stage 4 raw-class A-B-A suppression and nonoverlap runs
variant_definitions.scene_aware_plus_singleton: Stage 4.2 production-cut reset and within-scene A-B-A suppression
variant_definitions.simplified_cut_mask_plus_singleton: Exclude production-cut crossing flow, preserve raw direction history afterward, suppress within scenes, map to neutral/local evidence
variant_definitions.simplified_scene_reset_plus_singleton: Exclude production-cut crossing flow, clear direction history, suppress within scenes, map to neutral/local evidence

recommendation.contract: raw numeric flow descriptors with motion_present and conservative local_motion; no camera technique claims
recommendation.qualification: Keep motion out of semantic downstream reasoning until independent review confirms meaningful presence and local specificity
